# mvstmt: extract code with multiple return values
mv x.go:4,5 NewFunc
-- x.go --
package m

func F() {
	x := 1
	y := 2
	println(x, y)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go

+++ new/x.go

+	x, y := NewFunc()
+	println(x, y)
+}
